s.note: Creamy ham béchamel croquettes, crumbed and fried crisp
s.how: Melt 60g butter, cook 70g flour for 3 minutes, then whisk in 500ml hot milk and cook for 8 minutes until very thick. Stir in 150g finely chopped ham, nutmeg, salt and pepper, spread in a tray and chill for 4 hours. Shape into 20 logs, roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs and fry at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until deep golden.

s.note: Lightly sweet Jamaican fried cornmeal dumplings, crisp outside and soft in the middle
s.how: Mix 200g plain flour, 100g fine cornmeal, 40g brown sugar, 2 tsp baking powder and salt, stir in 200ml milk and knead to a firm dough. Rest 10 minutes, shape into 12 finger-length logs and fry in oil at 170C for 6 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through.

m.n: Matera orecchiette with broccolini and anchovy
m.note: Ear-shaped pasta tossed with broccolini, garlic, anchovy and chilli, pecorino and crunchy toasted breadcrumbs
m.how: Toast 60g fresh breadcrumbs in a tbsp of olive oil. Boil 400g orecchiette for 8 minutes, adding 500g chopped broccolini for the last 4. Meanwhile melt 6 anchovies with 4 sliced garlic cloves and a tsp of chilli flakes in the rest of the oil. Toss in the pasta and broccolini with a splash of pasta water, 40g pecorino and a lemon's zest and top with the crumbs.

w.note: Twisted Norwegian buns with cardamom dough, cinnamon butter and crunchy sugar
w.how: Knead 500g plain flour, 7g yeast, 80g sugar, 1 tsp cardamom, salt, 250ml warm milk, an egg and 75g soft butter for 10 minutes and rise for an hour. Roll to 40 x 30cm, spread with 90g butter beaten with 70g brown sugar, cinnamon and more cardamom, fold in thirds, cut 12 strips and twist each into a knot. Prove 40 minutes, brush with egg, scatter with pearl sugar and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

d.note: White rum, fresh lime, mint and sugar syrup over crushed ice, topped with soda
d.how: In each of 4 tall glasses gently muddle 8 mint leaves with 15ml sugar syrup and the juice of half a lime. Fill with crushed ice, add 45ml white rum and stir, then top with soda and finish with a mint sprig and a lime wedge.
